page.overview:
Who is Pets?

This is the list of all pets in the Fazbear Frights series.

Annabel Lee is Millie Fitzsimmons's black cat from Count the Ways. She is named after the character Annabel Lee from the poem of the same name by Edgar Allen Poe. Millie thinks the cat has a better name than her. Annabel Lee only appears once, curled up on Millie's bed as she's reading famous poems about death.

Two days after Christmas, Greg misses the bus and has to walk his bike home. When he passes his next door neighbors, their dog launches itself from an outdoor table and throws itself over the short fence right at Greg. He manages to catch the dog just as it hit his chest and snaps at his jugular. Greg pushes the dog back over the fence and runs away as it flings itself against the wooden boards. Greg texts Hadi about the incident and the dog shows up in his nightmares that night. The next day, Greg finds the neighbor's dog dead against the back wheel of his bike tire with its throat torn apart and its belly gutted. After disposing of the body in some bushes, Greg gets a text from Fetch saying, "YW." Greg tells Cyril and Hadi about the dead dog, and Hadi goes to see it.

Oro is Manuel Gomez's yellow Labrador from Fetch. Because Manuel is from Madrid, Oro only understands Spanish. One day, while Manuel is playing with Oro in his front yard, Greg texts Manuel asking for help with his Spanish homework. Manuel left his phone inside, and Greg believes Fetch may try to harm Manuel, so he learns his address and bikes to his house. Once learning Manuel is okay, Greg improves his Spanish while playing with Oro and a red ball.
